comment: Universe v2 (expanded 2026-08-24, ~4 sessions into the record): liquid, optionable ETFs whose share price lets one contract fit the 12% collateral cap ($6k on the simulated pool). ETFs avoid single-name earnings gaps while the IV-rank history bootstraps. EDIT THIS LIST YOURSELF - it is a liquidity-screened starting point, not a recommendation. Sector tags drive the 25% sector cap; correlated funds deliberately share a tag. Single names added later must carry hasEarnings: true so the catalyst check engages. No leveraged or futures-roll ETFs: the quality floor is 'only wheel what you would hold', and decay products fail it.
